<a id="body"></a>

## Body

PR 248 exposed a routing bug: lexical ancestors of A/alias -> B/sub find A/.git (or no repository when the alias is outside both), while git selects B. Canonicalizing only the final .git is insufficient: resolve the existing starting directory before ascending. Missing folders retain their original key; an undecidable existing path goes to Unknown. Pin both alias locations against git rev-parse. Shared consumers must compare canonical common-directory keys, including macOS /private aliases.

The repair also bounds gitfile/commondir reads: require regular files <=4096 bytes, read through take(4097), then reject overflow or invalid UTF-8. Unknown fallback answers have a 600-second TTL, but readable placement runs first so repairs apply immediately.

Zero ordinary git launches is not zero per-seat cost: the 60-second round does O((P+1)*N*D) filesystem work without folder deduplication. Pair spawn counters with daemon uptime to distinguish boot bursts from steady state; CI proof is not post-bounce live proof.

Encoded in root.rs placement regressions at de0296290966cf936c86e454bd9cebf1cbd949b1; final reviewer verdict c61a1fdb6b340aea652a902222c8b13fc00d7bf8 closed R248-1.
